# Print file preflight

> Free print-file preflight for artists and photographers: check implied DPI at a target print size, compare up to five export masters, and download a dated technical record before you pay for a proof. Runs entirely in your browser — artwork is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
